research_target: Public nonlocal oracle-dependent interference yielding accessible hidden-partner transport OR reproducible unconditional pair concentration on unfiltered sources, with a consequential reduction and matched baselines.

physical_interface.input: One fixed f_s(b,x)=pi(x-b*s) evaluation oracle, N=2^n.
known_operations: cyclic QFT and public even Fourier multiplier
physical_interface.verification: Distinct inputs with equal function values; four evaluation calls for a clean phase marker, two for final measured verification.
physical_interface.calibration_only: Explicit small source tables and hidden plus/minus bases are exponential verification machinery, not algorithm advice.

local_derivations.sector_identity: Seeded partner transport amplitude equals half the difference of plus/minus sector return amplitudes. This does NOT gate all independent-preparation strategies.
local_derivations.independent_preparations: Two fresh identical hidden-symmetric preparations have collision probability equal to the IPR of the unconditional position law. Reproducible pair concentration is an alternative to transport; no unknown-state cloning is granted.
local_derivations.conditional_record_falsifier: One measured coset has conditional IPR1/2, but two fresh random records match only1/N, giving unconditional partner yield1/(2N), not1/2.
local_derivations.selected_label_baseline: Costed known-label Grover preparation can concentrate on one coset, but costs O(sqrt(N)); its rank-one interpolation has protected-sector minimum gap1/sqrt(N) despite an irrelevant endpoint minus-sector degeneracy.
local_derivations.chirp_cut: Modulus-N quadratic Fourier driver preserves position parity for N divisible by four; odd shifts have exactly zero SEEDED second-walk yield, not zero independent-preparation yield.
local_derivations.local_driver_cut: For nearest-rotation/reflection driver with polynomial clock and diagonal kicks, a pointwise Dyson/word-ball bound gives polynomial/2^n collision yield; polynomial ordinary amplification does not rescue it.
local_derivations.marker_only_cut: Any oracle-independent preparation has sum_s p_s<=1; uniform-shift mean success after j ordinary amplification iterations is <=(2j+1)^2/N.
local_derivations.excluded_transfer: No general DHSP lower bound, no nonlocal-driver impossibility, no dequantization of all retained-domain protocols.

evidence.scaling_evidence: Exact scoped bounds only; finite pilot trends are not an asymptotic algorithm claim.
evidence.precision: Total composed trace error is explicit in the local bound; physical exponentially small probabilities require their own precision proof.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independent review of interaction-picture truncation, word geometry, source-average marker partition and amplification scope.
proof_obligations.PO-PUBLIC-PRIMITIVE: A nonlocal mechanism may depend on public indices and evaluated labels, not hidden reflection, unknown coset projector or free eigensystem.
proof_obligations.PO-SECTOR-CONTRAST-OR-CONCENTRATION: For seeded transport derive accessible-time plus/minus return contrast; for fresh preparations derive unconditional concentration with charged record alignment. A favorable conditional eigenvector/coset is insufficient.
proof_obligations.PO-UNFILTERED-SCALING: Prove success and resource scaling for unfiltered shifts and one fixed source permutation across calls; charge conditioning and source rarity.
proof_obligations.PO-TOTAL-COST: Account for A, A inverse, controlled powers, marker, known QFT/multiplier arithmetic, memory, precision and unknown-success scheduling.
proof_obligations.PO-BASELINES: Survive same-access classical birthday and algebraic/reconstruction attacks, phase-free marker search, and established DHSP quantum baselines; compare total runtime rather than one proxy.
proof_obligations.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Connect a successful source or structured promise to a consequential natural problem with parameter and error losses.
proof_obligations.PO-NO-CLAIM-PROMOTION: Workbenches, local bounds and tiny calibrations do not satisfy the candidate proof gate or establish novelty.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Public Fourier driver and clean oracle marker executed with A/A inverse.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: A gate needs hidden shift information, a supplied support reflection or an unknown-state copy.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Sector-return or two-fresh-preparation retained-domain success accounting.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: Seeded transport lacks partner contrast, fresh localization occurs on independently unmatched records, or success exists only after rare normalized postselection.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Held-out unfiltered nonlocal-driver sweeps after an analytic mechanism is specified.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: Yield remains O(1/N), oracle phases lose their matched phase-free budget, or parameter choices depend on source inspection.
Birthday recovery, natural algebraic reconstruction or established DHSP processing solves the same promise more cheaply.
An allowed phase changes hop support, word geometry exceeds its stated bound, or the marker-only argument uses oracle-dependent preparation.
